heading: AOC SFP Cable
bottomHtml:
SFP AOC Cable Price in Bangladesh – High-Speed 10G/25G/40G Optical Networking Solution


Upgrade your network infrastructure with SFP AOC Cable, the ideal high-performance and cost-effective solution for short-distance data transmission. Designed for data centers, enterprise networks, and high-speed server connections, these Active Optical Cables support blazing-fast speeds like 10Gbps, 25Gbps, and 40Gbps over multi-mode fiber.

In Bangladesh, where reliable and affordable networking hardware is in demand, SFP AOC cables are the perfect alternative to traditional transceivers and fiber patch cords. With built-in transceivers on both ends, these cables offer easy plug-and-play deployment, reduced power consumption, and enhanced signal integrity across short connections (1m to 30m).

Whether you're expanding your ISP backbone, upgrading a data center, or connecting high-performance switches and routers, SFP AOC cables are widely compatible with brands like Cisco, MikroTik, HPE, Fortinet, and more.

Key Features:

  • Available in 10G/25G/40G speed variants
  • Supports up to 30 meters (multimode fiber)
  • Integrated SFP+ or QSFP+ connectors – no separate module needed
  • Lower power consumption than optical transceivers
  • EMI immunity and better flexibility
  • Compatible with major switch/router brands
  • Cost-effective solution for high-speed short-distance links
